description: Open a new sub-account for this member
rationale: This mutates member/account state and cannot be trivially undone, so it is classified irreversible and requires confirmation. The app also raises its own native confirm() dialog as a second guard; discovery is accepting that dialog now because approving the happy path is the explicit goal of this recording. Replay must not do this unattended without pre-approval.
